summary: Massimo Group filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a loan agreement with its Executive Chairman David Shan for up to $4 million over one year at 4% interest, repayable June 22, 2027. The loan is unsecured and intended to fund strategic growth initiatives in technology-enabled products and autonomous mobility. The filing also notes termination of a previously announced letter of intent. No specific acquisition, divestiture, or shareholder return event is described; it is a related-party financing arrangement. Watch for future updates on strategic initiatives and potential dilution or restructuring.
